Bhavna Thakur
Senior Accountant | Kochi, Kerala
bhavna.thakur695@example.com | +91 9830468601

Senior finance professional with experience in accounting, reporting and process improvement across services and healthcare sectors. Strong track record delivering month-end closes, reconciliations and management reports using Excel and Tally with attention to IFRS alignment. Open to relocating to Bengaluru. Notice period: 15 days.

Experience

Senior Accountant, Onsite/Remote

- Collaborated with cross-functional teams via Jira to track accounting issues, document remediation steps and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.

Medisure — May 2018 - Nov 2020
Accounts Manager, Onsite
- Oversaw end-to-end accounting operations using Tally ERP 9, including AP/AR, payroll accruals and month-end journal entries, contributing to consistent on-time reporting.
- Implemented GST filing and compliance processes, preparing GST returns and reconciling tax ledgers which eliminated prior-period discrepancies and avoided penalties.
- Developed Financial Modeling tools in Microsoft Excel for cost analysis and service line profitability that informed pricing decisions and improved margin visibility by 10%.
- Coordinated with external auditors and ensured financial statements were prepared in line with IFRS considerations where applicable.

Automation of Reconciliation Workpapers
